title: Positivity-Preserving and Entropy-Stable Oscillation-Eliminating DGSEM for the Compressible Euler Equations on Curvilinear Meshes with Adaptive Mesh Refinement
summary: We extend the entropy-stable oscillation-eliminating discontinuous Galerkin spectral element method (ES-OEDG) on curvilinear meshes \cite{YangFu26} to adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) grids with nonconforming interfaces. The formulation is developed for two-dimensional curvilinear quadrilateral meshes with 2:1 refinement and a single level of hanging nodes. A central contribution is the design and analysis of interface fluxes.
